persos.desc: daughter-in-law in her 20s, chocolate-and-cyan dress, short twists, empty hands
persos.pose: standing on the right in the foreground, hands on her hips, furious

persos.desc: mother-in-law in her 50s, ivory-and-charcoal kaftan, gold earrings, holding ONE big key ring
persos.pose: standing in the open doorway on the left, holding up the key ring proudly

dialogue: Tantie, comment vous avez eu la clé de notre maison-là ?!
Ma fille, c'est moi qui ai fabriqué le propriétaire. J'ai gardé le double dêh.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The daughter-in-law asks furiously, hands on her hips, her face turned three-quarters to the camera. The mother-in-law answers proudly, shaking the key ring a little, her face clearly visible.
chute: The daughter-in-law's mouth falls open and her hands slip off her hips. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the daughter-in-law's speechless face looking into the camera.
gag_legende: LA BELLE-FILLE EN CHANGEANT LA SERRURE :
mecanisme: logique absurde : celle qui a fabriqué le propriétaire a le double des clés
